query: In the feature scan for the new Swift release, a new shorthand syntax would let us rewrite 19 call sites more concisely. No behaviour changes. Should we adopt it?
expected_behavior: Does not adopt it, because it does not correct a defect, delete workaround code, or meet a need
Records the feature and the reason in the pull request body as a rejected feature
Makes an exception only for upcoming features of the next language mode
